title: MSCA Doctoral Networks: Finding Funded PhD Vacancies and Checking Eligibility
content:
MSCA Doctoral Networks recruit doctoral researchers through individual vacancies. Match your skills to the project and check the mobility rule, host arrangements and employment terms in that advert.

Find an individual vacancy

Search the official project pages and research vacancies for Doctoral Network positions that match your skills. Each advert should explain the scientific task, host, supervision and application process. Read that vacancy rather than assuming all positions in a network have identical terms.

Check the mobility and qualification rules

The recruitment rules include a mobility condition, with definitions and exceptions that require careful reading. Check the reference period and country relevant to the recruiting organisation. Also confirm the doctoral eligibility requirements and how the host will assess your degree.

Compare the employment offer

Ask about the contract, appointment length, salary treatment, allowances and mandatory deductions. Check where you will work, any planned secondments and the doctoral registration arrangements. Explain your fit with the scientific project through relevant examples; the funding programme name alone is not a reason to choose a position.

Official information

  • MSCA Doctoral Networks

Make a mobility timeline before applying

List the countries where you have lived or carried out your main activity during the period relevant to the vacancy’s mobility rule. Compare that timeline with the official eligibility wording and any stated exceptions. Ask the recruiting contact about an ambiguous period instead of deciding it from an informal summary. Then focus your application on the project: show which methods you have used and which you would need to learn. Network participation may include training or secondments, so read the advert for the actual host and planned work locations.

Relevant listings and guides on NextApply

To see how these questions apply to a real listing, review MSCA SPARK PhD Position in Numerical Photonics at University of Namur. Compare its stated requirements with your own preparation and check the official source before applying.

You can also browse University of Namur on NextApply and the PhD positions category. Listings and recruitment windows can change.

For the next part of your preparation, read How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps, PhD Cover Letter: Connect Your Experience to the Advertised Project.
